title: The four risks that matter here

hotspots.label: Silent empty pages
hotspots.detail: About 1 in 400 list calls returns 200 with no items and no cursor before the true end. A full crawl must cover the whole scope, or the missing pages are deleted as stale.

hotspots.label: Oversized attachments
hotspots.detail: The largest attachment is 91 MB. Items over 64 MB index metadata and permissions only.

hotspots.label: Stale sandbox
hotspots.detail: The sandbox was refreshed 11 months ago. Validate against current permission patterns before sign-off.

hotspots.label: Credential rotation
hotspots.detail: Source tokens rotate every 90 days. Plan automated rotation for the Glean indexing token as well.

footnote: Case facts are fictional; the rules they trigger are sourced.
